title: Pure Genex
summary: Genex monsters with generic Synchro Monsters and staples. The old Genex searchers trigger on Normal Summon with no once-per-turn clause, and the 2024 cards turn that into a loop. R-Genex Magma searches a Level 2 R-Genex, R-Genex Crusher a Level 4 R-Genex, and R-Genex Turbo a Level 1 Genex. Repair Genex Controller, a Link-1 from any Level 4 or lower Genex, recovers a Genex from the GY. Each time a Genex is added to the hand, it grants another Normal Summon. R-Genex Turing Synchro Summons on the opponent's turn, R-Genex Undine becomes a Tuner and recovers two Genex, and Arms of Genex Return Zero negates monster effects by banishing monsters of the same Attribute. Repair Genex Controller limits the Extra Deck to Synchro Summons with a Genex Tuner, so the Extra Deck is all Synchro except the Link itself.
